snippet.title: [SMBX 2.0 Episode] Wario & the Tower of Garlic - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Embark on a new quest with everyone's favourite garlic-munching weirdo!
During a nightly drive, Wario notices an ominous tower... could there be treasure?!
This is a short adventure that you can play RIGHT NOW!
(You will need the latest version of SMBX2.0 to run this.)
CURRENT VERSION OF THE ADVENTURE - V1.0.6

DOWNLOAD LINK:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1S52NcPkSlylMYhN5xc5NfdQsGEF-8RKH?usp=drive_link
